item.title: Intigriti | Challenge 1026 Writeup
item.description:
Another Intigriti challenge and another writeup to detail its solution. The “Halloween Store” challenge involved an online store offering sweets. Our goal as players was to buy The Midnight Collection, the Halloween-themed archive that costs €666, while our balance was only €66. How? Well.. One, two, three coupons, and the flag is yours!

Recon

We land on the challenge page and decide to explore The Midnight Collection. (Kudos to Globules for challenge UI, one could feel the automn vibes 🍂)
